name: codebuddy
label: CodeBuddy Code
description: Tencent's CodeBuddy Code CLI — the same engine the WorkBuddy desktop app runs, driven headlessly
tagline: The terminal agent behind Tencent's WorkBuddy desktop app — same engine, same account, driven headlessly. Installed with npm.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_REGION
env_config.description: Which CodeBuddy site the account belongs to. `international` is codebuddy.ai / workbuddy.ai (Google or GitHub sign-in); `china` is codebuddy.cn / workbuddy.cn. An account only exists on one of them, and picking the wrong one fails as a login error rather than a routing error.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_API_KEY
env_config.description: CodeBuddy API key, for running without an interactive sign-in. Optional — leave blank if you signed in by running `codebuddy` and using /login on this machine.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN
env_config.description: Platform auth token, the alternative to an API key (an enterprise PAT, for example). Paste the token itself; a leading `Bearer ` is stripped for you.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id to run on. Leave empty for the account default. The CLI also accepts its aliases — default-model, fast-model, deep-model — which keep working when the underlying model is replaced.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_EFFORT
env_config.description: Reasoning effort for each run. Leave empty for the model's own default.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_MAX_TURNS
env_config.description: Maximum agentic turns per message. Leave empty for the CLI default; a run that hits the limit still returns the answer it reached.

env_config.name: CODEBUDDY_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Advanced. Endpoint override, for an enterprise or self-hosted deployment. Blank means the endpoint the region above selects.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Sign-in not confirmed. Set CODEBUDDY_API_KEY (press e), or run `codebuddy` and sign in with /login — there is no non-interactive login command. Auth is confirmed when you run a task.
